LanguageData.CK.Names.Hint: Only affects humans generated afterwards; the rename button only renames humans in the player faction.
LanguageData.CK.Relations.OldChance.Hint: Chance for each new colonist to know an existing colonist.
LanguageData.CK.Relations.AutoSworn: Auto sworn siblings at high opinion
LanguageData.CK.Relations.AutoSworn.Hint: When mutual opinion stays at 60 or above for 5 days, the pair becomes sworn siblings.
LanguageData.CK.Relations.Hint: Relations are save data; turning this off does not delete existing relations.
LanguageData.CK.Marriage.Hint: Primary spouse is the earliest spouse relation; the rest are secondary. Switching back to vanilla makes new weddings turn old spouses into ex-spouses again.
LanguageData.CK.About.Text:
Colony Surname ZH 0.1.0 Chinese names plus acquaintance, event, kinship, and marriage relations.
Data: Mods/ColonySurnameZh/Data/Names/*.txt — edit the surname and given-name pools directly. Settings: name chance, scope, nickname chance, old-acquaintance chance, auto sworn siblings, plastic besties, marriage system, and spouse cap.
Known limits: one bed per pawn, so extra spouses do not get extra beds; the vanilla social tab still uses the underlying husband/wife label, and primary/secondary labels are rewritten on the social relation rows.
LanguageData.CK.Gizmo.AdoptGodparent.Desc: Choose an adult at least 16 years apart, not blood-related, with mutual opinion of 20 or more, and become their godparent.
LanguageData.CK.Gizmo.AdoptGodparent.Invalid: The target is not eligible: must be an adult, 16+ years apart, not blood-related or a lover, mutual opinion 20+, and both sides under the godparent cap.
